# 1. Setup
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Signac)
  library(GenomicRanges)
  library(GenomicScores)
  library(phastCons100way.UCSC.hg38)
  library(GenomeInfoDb)
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tools)
})

set.seed(187)

SCRIPT_DIR    <- getwd()
PROJECT_ROOT  <- file.path(SCRIPT_DIR, "..")
DATA_DIR      <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "data")
OUTPUT_DIR    <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "output")
CAND_DIR      <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "candidates")
OUT_SCORE_DIR <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "feature_scores", "conservation")
dir.create(OUT_SCORE_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```


# 2. Inputs/Parameters
```{r}
seurat_path   <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "seo_RNA_ATAC_chr123.rds")

use_centerwin <- FALSE
center_width  <- 200L  
```


```{r}
message("Reading Seurat object: ", seurat_path)
seurat_obj <- readRDS(seurat_path)

# Peaks as GRanges
peaks_gr <- granges(seurat_obj[["ATAC"]])

# Align seqlevels styles to phastCons resource and trim to valid ranges
phast <- phastCons100way.UCSC.hg38
seqlevelsStyle(peaks_gr) <- seqlevelsStyle(phast)
peaks_gr <- trim(peaks_gr)

peaks_gr$peak_id <- paste0(seqnames(peaks_gr), "-", start(peaks_gr), "-", end(peaks_gr))

cons_full <- gscores(phast, peaks_gr, scores.only = TRUE)

cons_vec <- as.numeric(cons_full[["default"]])

cons_df <- data.frame(
  peak  = peaks_gr$peak_id,
  score = cons_vec,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

if (use_centerwin) {
  centers  <- resize(peaks_gr, width = 1,   fix = "center", ignore.strand = TRUE)
  win      <- resize(centers,  width = center_width, fix = "center")
  cons_win <- gscores(phast, win, scores.only = TRUE)
  cons_df$score_center <- as.numeric(
    if (is(cons_win, "DataFrame")) cons_win[["default"]] else cons_win
  )
}

# Persist base table
cons_file <- file.path(OUT_SCORE_DIR, "conservation_scores.tsv")
write_tsv(cons_df, cons_file)
message("Wrote per-peak conservation table: ", cons_file, " (", nrow(cons_df), " peaks)")


```

```{r}
make_peak_id <- function(chr, start, end) paste0(chr, "-", start, "-", end)

annotate_one <- function(cand_path, cons_tbl, out_dir) {
  nm <- basename(cand_path)
  message(" - Annotating: ", nm)

  cand <- read_tsv(cand_path, show_col_types = FALSE, progress = FALSE)

  # Ensure peak_id exists
  if (!"peak_id" %in% names(cand)) {
    needed <- c("peak_chr","peak_start","peak_end")
    if (!all(needed %in% names(cand))) {
      stop(sprintf("File %s must have either 'peak_id' or columns: %s",
                   nm, paste(needed, collapse = ", ")))
    }
    cand <- cand %>% mutate(peak_id = make_peak_id(peak_chr, peak_start, peak_end))
  }

  # Join conservation: cons_tbl has (peak, score[, score_center])
  x <- cand %>% left_join(cons_tbl, by = c("peak_id" = "peak"))

  # Derive celltype from "candidates_<celltype>.tsv"
  celltype <- sub("^candidates_(.+)\\.[^.]+$", "\\1", nm)
  if (identical(celltype, nm) || is.na(celltype) || nchar(celltype) == 0) {
    celltype <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(nm)  # fallback
  }

  out_file <- file.path(out_dir, sprintf("conservation_%s.tsv", celltype))
  write_tsv(x, out_file)
  message("   -> Wrote: ", out_file, " (", nrow(x), " rows)")
  invisible(out_file)
}

cand_files <- list.files(CAND_DIR, pattern = "^candidates_.*\\.tsv$", full.names = TRUE)

if (length(cand_files) == 0L) {
  message("No candidates_*.tsv files found in: ", CAND_DIR, "\nSkipping annotation.")
} else {
  message("Annotating ", length(cand_files), " candidate file(s) with conservation ...")
  invisible(lapply(cand_files, annotate_one, cons_tbl = cons_df, out_dir = OUT_SCORE_DIR))
  message("Done.")
}

```
